_comment: Example column-mapping config for CsvToInventoryImport.groovy. Copy this file, rename it (e.g. mapping.json), and edit the source column names to match YOUR CSV export. Run 'CsvToInventoryImport.groovy --input yourfile.csv --list-columns' to see the exact header names to use. The values below are illustrative source headers, not real data.

filter._comment: Optional. Keep only rows where the given source column equals the given value (case-insensitive). Useful when one export covers multiple warehouses but you're importing into a single OpenBoxes facility. Remove this block to import every row.
